svg.title: FSE trace matching the maternal heart rate: signal source unresolved
svg.desc: Four-minute synthetic strip. The rate recorded through a fetal scalp electrode runs at about 105 bpm and rises briefly to 115 with a contraction; the dashed maternal heart rate follows the same course. At 1.5 minutes the rates are marked as coinciding. The strip ends unresolved: independent confirmation of fetal rate and fetal life is required. External toco with contractions at 1 and 3 minutes.
